d.ko: Early 90s. You stayed in a quiet hotel for just one night and the next morning you’ve found out that the old world was destroyed. Alien dreams, secrets of your past and other guests that are turning into monsters. This hotel will not let you to check out.
d.en: Early 90s. You stayed in a quiet hotel for just one night and the next morning you’ve found out that the old world was destroyed. Alien dreams, secrets of your past and other guests that are turning into monsters. This hotel will not let you to check out.
d.zh: 90 年代初，你入住了某家僻静的酒店留宿一晚。然而隔天一早，你发现世界天翻地覆——诡异的梦境、过往的秘密以及变成怪物的住客。这家酒店绝不会放你离开。
